description:
SBA small business size standards (13 CFR 121.201, the eCFR table): a NAICS code, a code
    prefix (5415) or industry words -> receipts ($ millions) or employees, exceptions and
    footnotes, and the programs that use them. Each row also carries `proposed`: the standard
    SBA proposed on August 20, 2026 (91 FR 53741) for the code's 4- or 5-digit group, and whether
    it is higher, the same, or measured another way. The proposal is NOT in force: say so, and
    answer "am I small?" from today's standard. With `receipts` and/or `employees`, `simulation`
    says for each code whether a firm of that size is small today and would be under the proposal
    (newly_small, stays_small, stays_large).

employees.description: The firm's average number of employees (last 24 months), for the same test, e.g. 180.
employees.title: Employees

query.description: A 6-digit NAICS code (e.g. "541511"), a code prefix (e.g. "5415") or industry words (e.g. "custom software").
query.title: Query

receipts.description: The firm's average annual receipts in dollars (last 5 fiscal years), to test it against today's and the proposed standard, e.g. 40000000.
receipts.title: Receipts

name: size_standard
title: Check an SBA size standard
